findings.title: Include evidenced canonical-to-canonical turn start-to-complete
findings.resolution: Specify narrowly evidenced canonical-to-canonical G1 without downgrade or physical-event rewrite; retain original partial case and ordinary gap-free running canonical then completion regression.
findings.body: G1 explicitly permits same partial/provisional and canonical promotion but omits same canonical progression. Current Rust canonical gate proves safe snapshot coverage without requiring terminal turn; ordinary running history can already stage canonical TurnStarted. Later canonical TurnCompleted changes mutation content/source_ref and falls outside strict allowed cases, so save rejection remains after parse-gap repair.

findings.title: Make old checkpoint backfill parameters pass request validation
findings.resolution: Fix exact compatible request and limited validation scope; retain original old state and strict append/redelivery validation; include old non-null cursor case.
findings.body: Fresh-profile backfill requires cursor=null while permitting a valid target-v1 persisted_anchor. Such anchor may have non-null cursor; TargetAnalyzeRequest.validate requires anchor.cursor equal request.cursor before mapper/source compatibility can run. Recovery promise is unexecutable for that legal old state.
